kind: free P0 stabilization; isolated SQLite and actual browser cached audio

initial_regressions.reason: cached buffer did not reach actual playFeedback; errors swallowed by offerOpening

regression.scope: Python + Node, fixtures; not real providers/iPhone

browser.threshold_test: trace t0 deliberately set 3000ms in past; not real request latency

failure_policy.opening: skip; main answer continues; no synthesis retry or Denis
failure_policy.image: optional; completed text retained before slow visual finishes
failure_policy.tts: text/visual retained; no hidden fallback; no automatic followup
failure_policy.cli: local intents skip admission; no expensive fallback
failure_policy.stt: text entry remains; Whisper manual only

rollback: Deploy previous code in a separate checkout after checking active sessions; no reset/force, no DB migration; do not restore the old broken filler as a silent fallback.
backup: SQLite online backup including WAL; integrity_check OK; ignored data/backups; no schema migration
